description:
You are a database administrator for a travel agency using OrientDB's DemoDB. Data quality issues have been reported: hotels without names, invalid star ratings, profiles missing email addresses, and orders with negative prices.

Connect to the 'demodb' database (server credentials: root / GymAnything123!) and apply the following schema validation constraints:

1. Hotels.Name: Set MANDATORY to true and NOTNULL to true
2. Hotels.Stars: Set MIN to 1 and MAX to 5
3. Profiles.Email: Set MANDATORY to true and NOTNULL to true
4. Orders.Price: Set MIN to 0 (no negative prices)
5. Restaurants.Name: Set MANDATORY to true and NOTNULL to true
6. Reviews class: Enable STRICTMODE (set to true so only schema-defined properties can be stored)

You can apply these using SQL commands in OrientDB Studio's command/browse panel at http://localhost:2480/studio/index.html. Use ALTER PROPERTY for property-level constraints and ALTER CLASS for class-level settings.

Example syntax:
  ALTER PROPERTY Hotels.Name MANDATORY true
  ALTER PROPERTY Hotels.Stars MIN 1
  ALTER CLASS Reviews STRICTMODE true
